关键词: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco
主要内容: On February 9, 2016, Broadway Financial Corporation announced that the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco, with authorization from the Federal Reserve Board of Governors, had terminated the Order to Cease and Desist applicable to the company. This decision marks a significant regulatory development for the company, indicating that the regulatory action against it has been lifted. The company issued a press release and provided a letter terminating the Order to Cease and Desist as exhibits to the Form 8-K filing. The event is related to the company's regulatory status and its relationship with the Federal Reserve system.
